newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds see $15.74 bln April inflow - ICI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds see $15.74 bln April inflow - ICI.

text.p: Net flows to stock mutual funds were $15.74 billion in April compared with $10.75 billion in March, a mutual fund industry trade group said Thursday.
The latest figure was up from a $13.5 billion estimate for April issued over two weeks ago.
The Investment Company Institute said bond and income funds had inflows of $786.1 million in April compared with an outflow of $2.01 billion in March.
Money market funds had an outflow of $22.31 billion in April, compared with an inflow of $1.37 billion in March.
During the first four months of 1997, inflows into stock mutual funds totalled $73.73 billion, a decline of 25.2 percent from the $98.60 billion inflow during the same four months of 1996, ICI said.

New new cash flow for the entire mutual fund industry was a negative $5.78 billion in April due to the outflows from money market mutual funds. The mutual fund industry as a whole saw inflows of $10.11 billion in March.
